chapters.label: The winner, live
chapters.text: Miami, 2024, the Copa América final. Extra time, still nil-nil. Paredes wins the ball, Lo Celso slides it through, and Lautaro Martínez races away from Cuesta... and scores!

chapters.label: No waiting
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Lautaro sprints past Cuesta into the box. He does not wait: he shoots before Cuesta can block!

chapters.label: Champions
chapters.text: Past Vargas, into the net! One-nil in the 112th minute, and Argentina are champions again!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: His favourite finish is a quick turn and shot. Your turn: in the box, spin quickly and shoot before the defender can block!
